scope: CPU pretraining qualification under active mixed_dispatch_v1; no learning lineage or training corpus
capacity_contract: locks_equal_hosts_v1; one exclusive power domain per four hosts, cap two; one or two uniformly sampled locks per operation
placement_contract: affinity followed by one complete best-improvement placement pass under historical mixed FIFO score; identical and charged for every arm
selection: largest calibrated scale satisfying capacity and full proxy timing, at fixed 250 ms; no objective-gain selection
wall_control: all hand proposers plus native multi-start static/adaptive priority-swap search; full measured wall time including common placement; three repeats, conservative worst cost
hardness_statistic: largest ratio of summed improvements over baseline across fixed hand arms, separately at matched count and matched wall time; must be strictly under half in both
reference: best exact-accepted four-round structured descent and every retained hand outcome; feasible reference, not certified optimum
live_gate: all 16 qualification environments: baseline, structured reference, strongest fixed equal-wall-time hand arm; every operation audited even if offline bars fail
stop: Any failed qualification forbids training and GPU allocation; do not close the active parent. Residual graph information is evaluated only after headroom and hardness pass, using a separately frozen protocol and fresh seeds before any learner training.
future_residual_requirement: nonlocal move value beyond all supplied local features, typed 1/2/4-hop summaries, critical-path, lock-domain and setup controls; predictive error alone is not a graph witness
future_training_and_live_gate: Only after all CPU gates pass: register disjoint data, matched GNN/MP-OFF/hand-graph training via run_experiment.py with W&B and trainer determinism, then fresh paired live gate.
